<!-- Generated by `pnpm sync:docs` from Joevonlong/job-radar docs/README.md at 2947f47c185f. Do not edit: change the product repository and sync again. -->

File names such as `ai.yaml` or `data/config/ai.yaml` mean your own copy in `data/config/`; the shipped defaults in
`config/` are read-only (see [configuration.md](configuration/)). Most settings can also be changed on the Settings
page, or in its Advanced tab.

Start with `docker compose up -d --build` and the setup wizard at `/setup` (see [setup.md](setup/)). After the wizard, the
[tuning guide](../guide/getting-started.html) (open it in a browser) explains the pages and how to adjust what you get, with annotated
mock-ups.
